name: oil-motion
title_zh: 把滚动、指针、触摸、音频都变成网页动效的单一入口
tagline_zh: 产品页、图表、角色、转场——只要页面需要响应式动效，它就从设计到优化一条龙解释给你听，不用再拼凑五个库。
tagline_en: Scroll, pointer, drag, audio, tilt, data—one skill to design, build, and explain motion for any interactive page.
desc_en: Design, implement, optimize, and explain interactive web animations driven by scroll, pointer, drag, touch, device orientation, audio, data, or component state. Use when a webpage needs responsive visual motion for products, interfaces, diagrams, characters, or scene transitions.
why_zh: 它把动效的因果链拆开讲：先定状态机，再选驱动源，最后才写代码。别人给你代码，它给你为什么这段代码会动。
why_en: It separates motion into state machine → driver → code, so you understand why something moves, not just copy-paste a snippet.
limit_zh: 只认浏览器端 Web 动画，不碰 Canvas/WebGL 游戏渲染；需要你已有页面结构和设计稿，它不负责从零做视觉。
limit_en: Web DOM/CSS/JS animations only—no Canvas/WebGL game loops. Requires your existing page & design; outputs code with explanations, not a deployable app.
